reference_sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM products p
    JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
      AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
      AND ph.list_price_eur <= 100
  )
alternatives:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
WHERE 100 < (
  SELECT MIN(ph.list_price_eur)
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
    AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
)

WITH category_min AS (
  -- one row per category with products
  SELECT p.category_id, MIN(ph.list_price_eur) AS min_price_eur
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  GROUP BY p.category_id
)
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
JOIN category_min m ON m.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE m.min_price_eur > 100

other_way.sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name
FROM categories c
WHERE 100 < (
  SELECT MIN(ph.list_price_eur)
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE p.category_id = c.category_id
    AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
)
other_way.tradeoff: Comparing 100 with the lowest current price is shorter; a category with no products gets a missing minimum and drops out.
